test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Forest Research Institute, Dehradun was established as Imperial Forest Research Institute. In which year was it established as “Imperial Forest Research Institute”?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1906**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Forest Research Institute (FRI) **in **Dehradun,** India, traces its **origins back to 1878** when it was established as the **Forest School of Dehradun**.
 
• Later, in **1906, **it was reconstituted as the** Imperial Forest Research Institute**.
 
• FRI serves as a premier natural resource service training institute for the Indian Forest Service and State Forest Service.
 
• Situated in a census town nestled between Kaulagarh and the Indian Military Academy, FRI is bordered by the Tons River to the west.
 
• The institute's main building, designed by C.G. Blomfield in 1929, is a significant national heritage site, featuring Greco-Roman architecture.
 
• Additionally, the institute offers wheelchair-accessible facilities, including entrances and parking lots.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dehradun**, situated in the Indian state of** Uttarakhand**, serves as its capital and is also its most populous city.
 
• It functions as the administrative hub of the Dehradun district and falls under the jurisdiction of the Dehradun Municipal Corporation.
 
• The city hosts the winter sessions of the Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly, thereby serving as its winter capital.
 
• Nestled in the Garhwal region, Dehradun is home to the headquarters of its Divisional Commissioner.
 
• Recognized as one of the "Counter Magnets" of the National Capital Region (NCR), it is being developed to alleviate migration and population growth in the Delhi metropolitan area.
 
• Additionally, Dehradun aims to establish itself as a smart city in the Himalayan region.
